decisions.reason: The electronic church-motif music box combines traditional woodcraft with technology, the direction the firm has announced. It draws on in-house design and production investments, and seasonal sales swings can be read as temporary, so management will persist with it.
The nativity stable is a core seasonal item tied closely to the firm's established Christmas range and its retailer relationships, which makes it very unlikely to be withdrawn.

The modern incense smoker publicly signals the announced move toward contemporary designs. Its production is self-made and its markets are seasonal, so management will justify keeping it rather than admit the design push failed.
